name: Sugano Kaori
source:
A User that Chris brought along. She is physically weak and has trouble moving around. She also has a slim and thin appearance, while people also see her not looking like a girl to add on top.
She has been taking care of a boy and a girl who are around 5 years old ever since they are in a facility. Even after joining Gotou Faction, they do not seem to want to leave her side.
